title: Stock Market Today Live: Stock to buy today: SBI Life Insurance (₹1,820) - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Business professional calculating financial interest growth by stacking gold coins with glowing percentage symbol and calculator on desk, representing investment return, interest rate strategy | Photo Credit: Shutthiphong Chandaeng

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 13th November 2026

SBI Life Insurance’s stock has been rallying since the beginning of this month. On Thursday, it broke above resistance at ₹1,790.

The scrip also surpassed a trendline barrier, indicating that the trend is turning positive. The stock is likely to extend the rally from the current level. But after reaching ₹1,900, it could consolidate or correct slightly to ₹1,850. However, we expect the stock to eventually break out of ₹1,900 and rise to ₹1,980.

Therefore, traders can buy now at ₹1,820 and accumulate on a dip to ₹1,790. Place a stop-loss at ₹1,725. When the price touches ₹1,900, raise the stop-loss to ₹1,840. On a rally to ₹1,950, tighten the stop-loss to ₹1,900. Book profits at ₹1,980.

(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is a risk of loss in trading.)
